Pushed successfully. Budget is nearly exhausted, so I'll stop here with everything committed and pushed cleanly.

## Summary

`PHASE-2-CROSSREF` turned out not to be a document at all — it's the output of a prior DIRECTIVE-001 phase, stored in `sap_reports` (`/opt/veridian/ai-os/memory/sap_mapping.sqlite`): 36 rows tagged `engine_track='calculation'` with `BUILD_NEW`/`EXTEND_EXISTING` status. This exact task had been dispatched 14 times since 2026-07-29 and killed 13 times in a row by an unexplained dispatcher/resource-governor issue — not a work-content failure.

I found real, uncommitted engine code stranded in 2 of those dead attempts' worktrees and rescued it rather than re-deriving it:
- **FI-AR-006/FI-AP-006** — customer/vendor payment-behavior (DSO/DPO) scorecards
- **FI-AA-006** — fixed-asset-to-GL reconciliation
- **CO-001/CO-003** — cost-center drill-down + hierarchy roll-up
- **FI-GL-002/007/008** — GL balance display, subledger reconciliation, account-group roll-up

Resolved one real duplicate (both dead attempts had independently built FI-GL-007), registered all 8 functions in `wiring_registry` immediately, found and fixed a real `tsc` type error, verified `tsc --noEmit` clean, and opened **PR #643**. Committed in small increments throughout given the kill history.

28 of the 36 in-scope rows remain unbuilt (full breakdown in `PROGRESS.md`) — this session ran out of budget before reaching them. ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml is updated and left active for a future continuation.
